lines.japanese: 「はぁあああ～っ……」
lines.english: “Siiiiiiiiigh...”

lines.japanese: 退屈きわまる５０分が四度繰りかえされて、ようやく訪れた昼休み。
lines.english: Four supremely tedious fifty-minute periods repeated themselves before lunch break finally arrived.

lines.japanese: 精も魂も突きはてた俺は、頭を机に突っ伏したまま動かずにいました。
lines.english: With both body and soul utterly exhausted, I lay motionless with my head on the desk.
“Hah.”

lines.japanese: 気だるさに溜息さえ詰まる有様。
lines.english: I was too listless even to finish a sigh.

lines.japanese: ああ、情けない。
lines.english: How pathetic.

lines.japanese: そのうちに、教室の方々から弁当臭が漂いはじめました。
lines.english: Before long, the smell of boxed lunches began drifting from all around the classroom.

lines.japanese: ああ、昼メシか。俺も朝コンビニで買っといたパンでも食うかな。食欲あるかどうか微妙だけど……
lines.english: Oh, lunch. Maybe I should eat the bread I bought at the convenience store this morning. Though I wasn't sure I had an appetite...

lines.japanese: 「　オ　ハ　ヨ　ー　ゴ　ザ　イ　マ　ス　」
lines.english: “G O O D  M O R N I N G.”

lines.japanese: 「ドッキリか！」
lines.english: “Is this a hidden-camera prank?!”

lines.japanese: 何故だかアイドル寝起きレポ風のかすれ声が降ってきたので、つい芸人根性が刺激されて飛びおきてしまいました。
lines.english: For some reason, a hoarse voice descended on me like a TV reporter waking an idol, stimulating my comic instincts and making me leap upright.

lines.japanese: 見れば真正面に、マイク代わりのペットボトルを握った渡来レポーターが立っています。
lines.english: Before me stood Reporter Watarai, holding a plastic bottle in place of a microphone.

lines.japanese: どんだけ暇なのかなあ、このひと……。
lines.english: Just how bored was this woman...?

lines.japanese: 「何やってんすか明日香さん、俺いま休養ちゅ──」
lines.english: “What are you doing, Asuka? I'm trying to recuper—”

lines.japanese: 「今日は人気絶頂アイドル・鷲田ちとせちゃんの部屋にお邪魔しています」
lines.english: “Today, we've entered the bedroom of Chitose Washida, the idol at the height of her fame.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぽーん、ちとせでえす！　好きなお菓子は千歳飴でえす！」
lines.english: “Hiiii, I'm Chitose! My favorite candy is Chitose candy!”

lines.japanese: ああっ、振られたらつい乗っかってしまう俺もかなりの暇人！
lines.english: Ah! Being handed a setup made me play along. I was terribly bored too!

lines.japanese: 「ちとせちゃん、可愛らしい寝間着だねえ」
lines.english: “What adorable pajamas, Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「やだ～、そんなことないですぅ～」
lines.english: “Oh, no, they're nooothing special.”

lines.japanese: 「今日の下着は何色ですか？」
lines.english: “What color underwear are you wearing today?”

lines.japanese: 「ベージュです」
lines.english: “Beige.”

lines.japanese: 「初体験はいくつのときですか？」
lines.english: “How old were you when you lost your virginity?”

lines.japanese: 「ＡＶか！」
lines.english: “Is this porn?!”

lines.japanese: 「我が社を志望した動機はなんですか？」
lines.english: “Why do you wish to work for our company?”

lines.japanese: 「面接か！」
lines.english: “Is this a job interview?!”

lines.japanese: 「世界に絶対的な真理は存在しますか？」
lines.english: “Does absolute truth exist in this world?”

lines.japanese: 「哲学か！」
lines.english: “Is this philosophy?!”

lines.japanese: 「お昼ごはんはどうしてますか？」
lines.english: “What do you do for lunch?”

lines.japanese: 「普通か！」
lines.english: “Is this normal?!”

lines.japanese: 「うん、どーしてんすか。いつも昼休み教室にいないみたいだけど」
lines.english: “Yeah, what do you do? You never seem to be in the classroom during lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、ほんとにフツーの質問なわけね」
lines.english: “What? Oh, so that one really was a normal question.”

lines.japanese: ええと、昼メシは──
lines.english: Let's see, lunch—

lines.japanese: 「──まあ適当っすよ。できれば学食で食いたいんすけど、ここの食堂、部活のコネとか無いと席取り難しいでしょ。だから、朝パンとかおにぎりとか買っといて、その辺ぶらぶら歩きながら」
lines.english: “—whatever works. I'd eat in the cafeteria if I could, but getting a seat there is hard unless you have club connections. So I buy bread or rice balls in the morning and wander around while I eat.”

lines.japanese: しかし、なぜ突然そんなことをお尋ねに？
lines.english: But why had she suddenly asked?

lines.japanese: 「じゃー玉泉とふたりっきりで、ラブラブしく弁当を突ついてるわけじゃないんすか」
lines.english: “So you aren't poking lovingly at a lunch with Tamaizumi, just the two of you?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはっ！」
lines.english: “Pfft!”

lines.japanese: 「動揺した」
lines.english: “He flinched.”

lines.japanese: 「とつぜん脈絡もないこと言われたから、びっくりしただけです」
lines.english: “Only because you said something completely out of nowhere.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとは普通そんなことで驚きません。つまり普通じゃない、インモラルなところがあるのでしょう」
lines.english: “Ordinary people don't react that way. Therefore, something abnormal and immoral must be happening.”

lines.japanese: 「強引か！」
lines.english: “What a leap!”

lines.japanese: 「けしからん。玉泉とふたりっきりで、インモラルな突つき合いをしているに違いない」
lines.english: “Shameful. You and Tamaizumi must be poking each other immorally in private.”

lines.japanese: 「狩男か！」
lines.english: “Are you Karuo?!”

lines.japanese: 「恐怖、ベージュの下着に欲情する男」
lines.english: “Terror: The Man Aroused by Beige Underwear.”

lines.japanese: 「俺か！」
lines.english: “That's me?!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、ウソ！　いまのウソウソ、冗談です！　引かないで！」
lines.english: “Oh, that was a lie! A joke! Don't be disgusted!”

lines.japanese: ふう、危うくベージュフェチの色情狂にされるところだった……。
lines.english: Whew. I had nearly been turned into a beige-fetish sex maniac...

lines.japanese: ああもう、なんでこのひと、俺にはヘンな絡み方してくるかな。
lines.english: Honestly, why did she always accost me in such strange ways?

lines.japanese: もう明日香さんには知られちゃったけれど、できれば知られたくなかったなあランキング。
lines.english: Asuka had already found out, but on the list of things I would rather she had not known...

lines.japanese: まあ一位は言わずもがなとして、次ぐ第二位。それは“俺と日和子さんの交際”。
lines.english: First place went without saying. In second place was my relationship with Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: ふたりが同じ学校なのは知ってましたけどね、まさか日和子さんと直接の交流があったとは。
lines.english: I knew the two attended the same school, but I had never imagined Hiyoko knew her personally.

lines.japanese: ま、驚いたのは、もちろん俺だけじゃなかったすけどね。
lines.english: Of course, I wasn't the only one surprised.

lines.japanese: 日和子さんの場合。
lines.english: In Hiyoko's case:

lines.japanese: 付きあいはじめた自分の彼氏が、親しい先輩の仮面彼氏だったと知って。
lines.english: She learned that her new boyfriend had been posing as the boyfriend of a senior she knew well.

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「え、すみません、もう一度説明していただけますか」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Could you explain that again?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、羽田さん……ていうのは、つまり千歳さん、ですよね？　が？　はあ、渡来先輩と……はあ、三年前から……」
lines.english: “So Haneda... is Chitose, yes? And he...? With Watarai...? For three years...?”

lines.japanese: 「はあっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 明日香さんの場合。
lines.english: In Asuka's case:

lines.japanese: 三年来の仮面彼氏がついに本当の彼女を作り、その相手が親しい後輩だったと知って。
lines.english: She learned that her pretend boyfriend of three years had finally found a real girlfriend, who happened to be a junior she knew well.

lines.japanese: 「え？　え？　なにが？　えっ？」
lines.english: “What? What? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　羽田君……じゃないけど羽田君的な……が？　玉泉と？　デキちゃった？」
lines.english: “So Haneda... who isn't Haneda, but is sort of Haneda... and Tamaizumi? They're together?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「……ごめ、ちょっと整理する。３０秒待って」
lines.english: “...Sorry. Let me sort this out. Give me thirty seconds.”
(Thirty seconds later.)

lines.japanese: 「えええええ？」
lines.english: “Whaaaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: ま、そんなよーなてんやわんやを経つつ。
lines.english: After weathering that sort of commotion,

lines.japanese: とりあえず三年弱つづいた羽田鷹志×渡来明日香の恋人ごっこは、晴れて解約とさせていただきました。
lines.english: the nearly three-year pretend romance between Takashi Haneda and Asuka Watarai was officially and happily terminated.

lines.japanese: ええ、だって、もともと「甲または乙いずれかに、正式なパートナーの出来るまで」という契約でしたからね。
lines.english: After all, the original agreement lasted “until either Party A or Party B obtains an official partner.”

lines.japanese: 「で？　なんでお昼、玉泉と食べないんすか。上手くいってないんすか」
lines.english: “So? Why don't you eat lunch with Tamaizumi? Are things going badly?”

lines.japanese: 失礼な。
lines.english: How rude.

lines.japanese: 「そんなんじゃないっすよ。日和子さんは一年のときからずっと、お友達とふたりでランチしてきたんです。俺がその歴史を無視していきなり日和子さん取っちゃったら、残された子にカンジ悪いでしょ」
lines.english: “Nothing like that. Hiyoko has eaten lunch with the same friend since her first year. If I ignore all that history, swoop in, and steal Hiyoko away, won't the girl left behind think I'm a jerk?”

lines.japanese: 「そーすかあ？　そんな、赤の他人ばっか立ててないで、ちゃんと彼女第一で考えてあげなー？」
lines.english: “Really? Stop putting some total stranger first and remember your girlfriend comes before her, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: ときどきナチュラルに命令形使ってくるよなあ、この王女さま。妙にハマッてて違和感ないけど。
lines.english: This princess slipped into giving orders awfully naturally sometimes. It suited her so well that it barely seemed strange.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、バイト先の尊敬する先輩にも言われたんすよね。カノジョの女友達に嫌われるような男にはなるなって」
lines.english: “Yeah, a guy I really respect at work told me that, too. Don’t be the kind of boyfriend her friends hate.”

lines.japanese: ああ、でも、その友達さんって子にはまだ会ったことなかったな。こんど紹介してもらお──
lines.english: Oh, but I still hadn't met that friend. I should ask for an introduction sometime—

lines.japanese: ──あ、いや、日和子さんとウマが合うぐらいだから、たぶん規律を重んじるキリッとした風紀委員タイプだよな。う、ちょっと恐そうだ。無理して会うこともないか。
lines.english: —or perhaps not. Anyone who got along with Hiyoko was probably a stern, rules-first disciplinary-committee type. That sounded frightening. There was no need to force a meeting.

lines.japanese: 「というかですね。日和子さんとの共通見解として、そもそも学校ではあまり会わないようにしてるんです、うちら」
lines.english: “Besides, Hiyoko and I agreed not to see each other much at school in the first place.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「俺、こういう身なんで。卒業まで目立つ行動は控えようかと」
lines.english: “Because of my situation. I'm trying not to attract attention until graduation.”

lines.japanese: 言ったでしょ。残された日々を、水のように空気のように過ごしたいって。
lines.english: I told you. I wanted to pass these remaining days like water, like air.

lines.japanese: 学園じゃ仮にも羽田鷹志はプリンセス明日香さまのお相手として認知されてるのに、このうえ美人の後輩にまで手を付けたーなんて風評が広まったら最悪じゃないですか。
lines.english: At school, Takashi Haneda was nominally known as Princess Asuka's partner. If rumors now spread that he had also put the moves on a beautiful junior, it would be a disaster.

lines.japanese: 惚れた腫れたのスキャンダルは、浸透率も伝播速度もハンパないっすから。
lines.english: Romantic scandals spread with terrifying reach and speed.

lines.japanese: 「そうは言っても、玉泉は寂しがってんじゃない？　たまにはお昼誘ってあげなよ」
lines.english: “Even so, don't you think Tamaizumi gets lonely? Invite her to lunch once in a while.”

lines.japanese: 「とんでもない。あのひと極度の恥ずかしがりぃですよ、むしろ学校では向こうが俺を避けてるフシあるし」
lines.english: “No way. She's painfully shy. If anything, she seems to avoid me at school.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなの？」
lines.english: “Really?”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんすよ、わりとそーゆーとこあるんすよ。ちょっと冷たいっすよねえ」
lines.english: “Really. She can be like that. It's a little cold, don't you think?”

lines.japanese: 「まあそうね。うん。じゃあ、そのあたりは玉泉に不満があるんだ？」
lines.english: “Yeah, I guess. Uh-huh. So that’s something you don’t like about Tamaizumi?”

lines.japanese: 「や、お互い様なんで、不満ってゆーわけじゃないんすけどー」
lines.english: “Well, I do it too, so I wouldn’t say I’m unhappy about it...”

lines.japanese: ん？
lines.english: Hm?

lines.japanese: 「──てか明日香さん、さっきから質問ばっかッすね」
lines.english: “—wait, Asuka. You've been asking nothing but questions.”

lines.japanese: んん？　このひと、そんな他人の色恋沙汰にグイグイ首つっこむようなタイプだっけ？
lines.english: Hmm? Was she really the type to stick her nose so aggressively into other people's love lives?

lines.japanese: ……怪しいな。
lines.english: ...Suspicious.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、ひょっとしてアナタ、俺になんか口走らせようとしてません？　日和子さんへの不満とか」
lines.english: “Um, are you trying to make me blurt out some complaint about Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: 「ちっ」
lines.english: “Tch.”

lines.japanese: 「当たりかよ」
lines.english: “So I was right.”

lines.japanese: ていうことはっ！？
lines.english: Which meant—?!

lines.japanese: やっぱり。振りかえると、戸口の向こうに玉泉日和子さんそのひとが待機していました。
lines.english: I knew it. Looking back, I found Hiyoko Tamaizumi herself waiting beyond the doorway.

lines.japanese: 下級生として、中へ踏みこむのはためらわれるのでしょう。体を半分隠して遠慮がちに覗きこんでいます。
lines.english: As a younger student, she was presumably hesitant to enter. Half hidden, she peered inside with reserve.

lines.japanese: 目が合ったら、かくっと硬い会釈をよこしました。さすがの日和子さんでも、最上級生の教室は緊張するみたいです。
lines.english: When our eyes met, she gave me a stiff little bow. Even Hiyoko seemed nervous outside the senior classroom.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、来てたんならすぐに教えてくださいよ！」
lines.english: “You should've told me she was here!”

lines.japanese: 「私の計画では、ちょうど玉泉への不満ぶちまけが最高潮に達したところで、背後のワゴン車からご本人登場という」
lines.english: “My plan was to reveal Tamaizumi from the van behind you at the precise moment your complaints about her reached their climax.”

lines.japanese: 「ドッキリ継続中！？」
lines.english: “The hidden-camera show is still going?!”

lines.japanese: 「俺の計画では、そのあと女仕掛け人を投入して、痴情のもつれを誘発するという」
lines.english: “My plan was to send in a female accomplice afterward and provoke a romantic catastrophe.”

lines.japanese: 「二重トラップ！？」
lines.english: “A second trap?!”

lines.japanese: 「ハイハイハイ女仕掛け人ＤＥＡ──ＴＨ！　私の計画では最後爆発オチどかーん！」
lines.english: “Hellooo! Your female accomplice—to DIE for! My plan ends with an explosion! Kablooey!”

lines.japanese: 「バァ──ニング！　これがホントの燃えあがる恋ィィィ！」
lines.english: “Buuuurning! Now that's what I call love on fire!”

lines.japanese: 「って、やかましいわ」
lines.english: “Will you all shut up?”

lines.japanese: いつの間にか集まっていた番組スタッフを蹴散らして、ゲストの待つスタジオへ走りました。
lines.english: I scattered the television crew that had gathered behind me and ran to the studio where our guest waited.

lines.japanese: いや、スタジオじゃなくて廊下ですけどね。
lines.english: Well, the hallway, not a studio.

lines.japanese: ゲストもとい日和子さんは、そこに手荷物を提げて待っていました。
lines.english: Our guest—or rather, Hiyoko—stood there holding a parcel.

lines.japanese: 「ど、ども」
lines.english: “H-hey.”

lines.japanese: 「ども」
lines.english: “Hello.”

lines.japanese: ぺこり。ぺこり。
lines.english: Bow. Bow.

lines.japanese: 申しあげたとおり、基本的に校内での面会は避けているので、たまにこうして顔を突きあわせると妙な緊張が走ります。
lines.english: As I said, we generally avoided meeting at school, so the rare occasions when we faced each other produced a peculiar tension.

lines.japanese: 「や、お待たせしちゃってすいませんっした。明日香さんが、日和子さん来てるってなかなか教えてくれなかったもんで」
lines.english: “Sorry to keep you waiting. Asuka took her time telling me you were here.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、はい、そんなことだろうとは思ってました。大丈夫です。渡来先輩に呼び出しをお願いした時点で、そのぐらいは折り込み済みですから」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. I assumed as much. It's all right. I accounted for that when I asked Watarai to call you out.”

lines.japanese: なるほど。さすが俺より付き合い長いだけあるんすね。
lines.english: I see. She had known Asuka longer than I had.

lines.japanese: 「でも、珍しい……っていうか初めてですよね、日和子さんがここまで来るの。どうしたんすか」
lines.english: “Still, this is unusual... Actually, it's your first time coming up here, right? What's going on?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。あの、しゅ……先輩は」
lines.english: “Yes. Um, Shuu—could I ask...?”

lines.japanese: 学校で千歳さんとか鷲介さんとか呼ばれるのもアレなので、単に先輩と呼んでもらっています。
lines.english: Having her call me Chitose or Shuusuke at school would be awkward, so I’d asked her to avoid using my name there.

lines.japanese: 「今日、お昼どうされました？」
lines.english: “What are you doing for lunch today?”

lines.japanese: 「昼メシっすか？　これからパン食おうと思ってたとこですけど……」
lines.english: “Lunch? I was about to eat some bread...”

lines.japanese: と言いながら気付いたこと。日和子さんが手にしてるの、弁当の包みっぽい？
lines.english: As I answered, I noticed something. Was that parcel in Hiyoko's hands a wrapped lunch box?

lines.japanese: 「あれはアレか。愛妻弁当か」
lines.english: “Is that what they call a loving wife's lunch?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、必死なビッチの最終手段と言われるアレだな」
lines.english: “Ah. The desperate bitch's last resort.”

lines.japanese: 「うそ、おべんと！？　おべんと使っちゃうの、やだ不潔！　アレは媚薬だよ反則だよ飛び道具だよ。あんなの出されたら抵抗できるわけないよ。そこまでして彼氏を繋ぎとめたいんだ、すごい！　必死すごい！」
lines.english: “No way, a homemade lunch?! You're really using one? How filthy! That's an aphrodisiac, a foul, a ranged weapon! No man could resist that. You're that desperate to keep your boyfriend? Amazing! Desperately amazing!”

lines.japanese: なんか……背後からなんか、楽しそうな野次が聞こえてくる……。
lines.english: Cheerful heckling drifted from somewhere behind us...

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん、ちょっと向こうへ」
lines.english: “Hiyoko, let's move over there.”
“All right...”

lines.japanese: 律儀に冷やかし上級生たちへ会釈していた彼女を連れて、廊下の隅へ避難しました。
lines.english: I escorted her away to a corner of the hall while she dutifully bowed to the jeering upperclassmen.

lines.japanese: 「え、そんで日和子さんはどうしたんですか、お昼。いつも一緒に食べてるお友達は？」
lines.english: “So what happened to your lunch, Hiyoko? What about the friend you always eat with?”

lines.japanese: 「それが……今日その子、ちょっと具合が悪いみたいで。朝から青い顔してたんで、むりやり保健室連れてって寝かしつけてきました」
lines.english: “Well... She seemed ill today. She'd looked pale since morning, so I forced her into the nurse's office and made her lie down.”

lines.japanese: 「あらー、風邪っすかねえ。こじらせなきゃいいけど」
lines.english: “Oh dear. Think it's a cold? I hope it doesn't get worse.”

lines.japanese: 「熱はぜんぜんなかったし、本人もただの寝不足だって言ってるんで、心配はないと思います」
lines.english: “She had no fever at all and said she was only sleep-deprived, so I don't think there's any need to worry.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、あの……」
lines.english: “So, um...”

lines.japanese: ふたりでお昼しましょう。日和子さんがそんな簡単なことを言いよどんでしまうのは、学校でむやみに会うのは控えようってルールをふたりで定めたからなんでしょう。
lines.english: *Let's eat lunch together.* Hiyoko hesitated over that simple invitation because we had agreed not to meet needlessly at school.

lines.japanese: たまには上級生の彼氏とランチしたいなんて思っちゃってる日和子さんも可愛いし、そんな些細なワガママを言いだせずモジついちゃってる日和子さんも可愛いし──
lines.english: Hiyoko was adorable for wanting lunch with her older boyfriend once in a while, and adorable for squirming rather than voice such a tiny selfish wish—

lines.japanese: ──ま何より、制服姿の下級生然とした日和子さんが理屈抜きに可愛いんですよ。
lines.english: —but more than anything, Hiyoko in uniform, every inch the younger student, was simply adorable beyond reason.

lines.japanese: とりあえずフッと息など吹きあげて。
lines.english: I gave my bangs a puff of breath.

lines.japanese: ま、いいっすよね、たまには。こういう機会もそうそうないことだし。
lines.english: Once in a while was fine. Chances like this hardly came often.

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん。今日はいっしょに食べましょうか」
lines.english: “Hiyoko. Shall we eat together today?”

lines.japanese: 「え、でも……大丈夫、ですか？」
lines.english: “But... will it be all right?”

lines.japanese: 「ま、ダイジョブっすよ多分。自分で言うのもなんだけど、いまさら羽田鷹志の動向に注目するひともいないでしょ」
lines.english: “Well, probably. Not that it’s much to brag about, but who pays attention to Takashi Haneda anymore?”

lines.japanese: 「私たちが彼の声を聞いたのは、それが最後でした」
lines.english: “That was the last time we heard his voice.”

lines.japanese: 「まさかあの油断が命取りになるとはなァ。あいつらしいポップな散り様だ」
lines.english: “Who'd have thought that carelessness would prove fatal? A fittingly breezy death.”

lines.japanese: 「星になった魂に、ばんざーいばんざーい！　千歳ばんざーい！」
lines.english: “Three cheers for the soul that became a star! Hooray, hooray! Long live Chitose!”

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん、まずは遠くへ行きましょう。学園敷地の果てへ行きましょう」
lines.english: “Hiyoko, let us begin by going far away. To the very edge of the school grounds.”
